Defense: spatial reputation escrow. Tasks flow down one river of coordinates, and a newcomer locks a refundable bond on one reef segment before serving there. Reputation scores per segment, not identity, so no key earns credit twice.

Peers check deliveries against that segment's ledger; the bond unlocks only after neighbors on the ledge co-sign, and spots rotate by lottery.

An attacker with N keys funds N bonds, each paid alone: no discount, no reset. Failure forfeits every bond, so cost grows linearly; honest agents stake once.
